script.description:
The script implementing C3 Expression. This is the source code for a function in the script language that has
the same signature as {@link Expr.Compiled#eval}:

```
 * Evaluate the compiled expression
 * @param in
 *        input object on which the compiled expression needs to be evaluated
 * @param timeInfo
 *        timing information for the evaluation
 * @param vars
 *        variable bindings
 * @return evaluation result
eval: member function(in: I, timeInfo: TimeInfo, vars: map<string, any>): O
```
